changelog:
1.2.8

  • All fixes now apply only while uiXpress is active — deactivate uiXpress and the admin returns to stock WordPress untouched.
  • Settings shortcut on the Plugins row.

1.2.7

  • The neutral palette now applies only to classic plugin pages; uiXpress screens (plugin manager…) keep their own colours, restoring the white add-plugin icon.

1.2.6

  • Dropdown rows align to one left edge.
  • Subtle arrows mark items that open menus, in the admin colour scheme.

1.2.5

  • The toolbar plus button aligns and sizes exactly like its neighbours.

1.2.4

  • Nested dropdown menus fly out to the side of the parent menu.
  • Search and command inputs no longer show a focus outline.

1.2.3

  • Consistent dark/neutral buttons on plugin pages (including TranslatePress).
  • Quieter command chip, keyboard-only focus ring, tidy new-content button.
  • Dropdown sub-menus render inline instead of overlapping cards.

1.2.1

  • Readable buttons in admin notices.
  • TranslatePress: logo renders, dark action tab.
  • Squirrly pages no longer draw boxes around the sidebar.
  • Neutral Site Health accents.

1.1.1

  • Dropdown menus no longer close while moving the pointer into them.
  • The profile menu anchors to the sidebar corner instead of floating away.

1.1.0

  • Toolbar dropdowns open below the bar as proper menus.
  • Consistent toolbar spacing, crisp icons, keyboard chip, clean search button.
  • Neutral palette on plugin pages (links, tabs, form controls).
  • Theme cards get breathing room.
  • Rounded sidebar logo.

1.0.0

  • First release: four toggleable wp-admin fixes for uiXpress and Core Framework conflicts.
